heading: Thursday Night
text: Chance of an evening shower, mainly northeast, then partly cloudy. Patchy valley fog. Lows from the upper 50s to mid 60s. Southwest winds 5 to 10 mph, becoming west and diminishing.

heading: Friday
text: Patchy valley fog early, then variable clouds. Slight chance of an afternoon shower from the Adirondacks and Route 2 northward, except chance near the Vermont/Québec border. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s, some upper 70s far south. West to northwest winds 5 to 10 mph.

heading: Saturday
text: Patchy fog early, then partly to mostly cloudy. Chance of afternoon showers along and west of the Greens; a rising chance to the east. Highs in the low to mid 70s south and in the Champlain Valley upper 60s to lower 70s elsewhere north. North winds 5 to 15 mph.
